definitions.explanation: The melting of accumulated snow, especially as managed on roads and roofs in snowy regions; also seen in the names of equipment and agents for melting snow.

examples.japanese: {春|はる}の{融雪|ゆうせつ}が{始|はじ}まった。
{道路|どうろ}に{融雪|ゆうせつ}パイプが{埋|う}めてある。
examples.english: Snow-melting pipes are buried in the road.

examples.japanese: {融雪|ゆうせつ}による{増水|ぞうすい}で{川|かわ}が{危険|きけん}になることがある。
examples.english: Rising water from snowmelt can make rivers dangerous.

notes:
The melting of accumulated snow. In snowy regions it often refers to engineered snow removal: {融雪|ゆうせつ}{装置|そうち} (snow-melting systems) spray warm water or run heat beneath roads.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {融雪|ゆうせつ}{剤|ざい}: snow-melting agent (de-icer)
- {融雪|ゆうせつ}{装置|そうち}: snow-melting equipment
- {融雪|ゆうせつ}{期|き}: the thaw season

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {雪解|ゆきど}け: thaw — the everyday word for snow melting in spring
